messages:
sanjay: Heads up — seeing ~1.6k mTLS handshake failures in eu-west over the last 10m after the RBAC tweak for the kms-keystore-unwrap role. Errors show KMS AccessDenied and proxy keystore unwrap failures.

ops-bot: ALERT: mTLS handshake failure spike (inference-proxy-eu-*) — cert-rotator reporting KMS Decrypt denies. https://alerts.internal/incident/INC-4591 :rotating_light:

mike: Can you paste the exact proxy/rotator log lines?

sanjay: Sure, snippet:
```
2026-03-21T11:02:12Z proxy[proxy-eu-1]: handshake failed: keystore unwrap failed: kms.DecryptAccessDenied: CallerIdentity=svc:rotator@eu-west
2026-03-21T11:02:13Z rotator[rotator-0]: failed to unwrap WRAPPED_KEY for csr-abc123: AccessDenied
```

jenna: That RBAC change was the 11:00 rollout — we removed kms:Decrypt for the rotator SA in eu-west to tighten scope. We didn't realize rotator is used for edge proxy unwraps as well.

alexa: Confirmed — rotator handles ephemeral cert enrollment: CSR -> signed certs are wrapped with KMS-wrapped key material. If rotator can't unwrap the key wrapping token, proxies cannot complete mTLS handshake and will drop connections.

mike: Do KMS audit logs show Decrypt denies? I only see CreateKey/Encrypt entries for the window.

security-bot: AUDIT QUERY: No KMS Decrypt events for service account 'svc/rotator' in eu-west during the incident window. Possible audit-forwarder filter misconfiguration. Creating ticket SEC-1123.

sanjay: So we're looking at two problems: the RBAC change (root cause) and missing Decrypt audit events (observability gap). Immediate mitigation suggestions?

jenna: Options: 1) revert the RBAC tweak for rotator in eu-west (fast), 2) scale rotator down and use pre-warmed cert bundle (safer but slower), 3) allow proxies to fall back to cached certs if unwrap fails.

alexa: Rollback role now and enable fallback to cached bundle. We have a pre-warmed bundle in s3: s3://redwood-prewarm/eu/proxy-bundle.tar.gz that proxies can temporarily load.

mike: Reverting RBAC via iamctl (will run):
```
iamctl patch role rotator-eu --add-perm kms:Decrypt --resource arn:aws:kms:eu-west:...:key/keystore
``` 
I'll run and report back.

sanjay: I ran a quick tls check:
`openssl s_client -connect inference-proxy.eu-west.redwood.ai:443 -servername inference-proxy.eu-west.redwood.ai -tls1_3`
Result: TLS alert decode_error, no cert chain returned from server.

jenna: Postmortem checklist notes here: add alert for KMS:Decrypt denies, ensure audit-forwarder doesn't drop Decrypt events, update rotator runbook to document keystore unwrap perm, add RBAC change canary that runs an unwrap test in staging on PR.

alexa: Also consider temporary mitigations for future rotations: enable OCSP stapling fallback and extend stapling TTL for proxies, and increase session-ticket grace to avoid mass client disconnects during short outages.

sanjay: Assigning owners: mike — revert RBAC (in progress), jenna — verify rotator annotations and redeploy if needed, alexa — push audit-forwarder fix & alert rule, I'll compile incident notes and followups.

mike: Reverted and applied patch. iamctl output: role patched. Monitoring metrics now.

ops-bot: RESOLVED: mTLS handshake failure spikes returned to baseline after RBAC rollback (4m). https://metrics.internal/dashboard/handshake-eu-west :white_check_mark:

sanjay: Thanks. Concrete followups: add CI unwrap test that runs `openssl s_client` + KMS unwrap smoke in PRs that change RBAC; add alert for cert-rotator KMS errors; add audit-forwarder integration test for Decrypt events.

jenna: I'll put SEC-1124 in the sprint for the RBAC canary + runbook updates. Owner: jenna.

security-bot: Ticket SEC-1123 (missing decrypt audit) created and triaged. SEC-1124 (RBAC canary + runbook) created and assigned.

alexa: Leaving a note — we should also add a simple k8s readiness probe in proxies that fails open if cert unwrap transiently fails but backend is healthy, to reduce user impact during short rotations.

sanjay: Good call. Closing this thread now; I'll write the incident summary and known mitigations. :memo:
